result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and signalized traffic control, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes create a long, unprotected crossing distance that increases exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a physical median or refuge island leaves pedestrians vulnerable in the middle of a wide street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk and a marked zebra crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure is present, there is a lack of physical buffers between the walkway and the roadway, and no dedicated pedestrian signals are visible.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't walk signal is visible for the crosswalk, which may lead to confusion or unsafe crossings as pedestrians rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corner near the traffic light pole

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation such as trees, bollards, or planters between the wide sidewalk and the active roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line adjacent to the building

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance for crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicle traffic.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane urban arterial with high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Risk
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration allows for vehicles in one lane to block the view of pedestrians for drivers in adjacent lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and sidewalks on all corners. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of a median or refuge island increase pedestrian exposure during crossings.

hazards.name: Extended Pedestrian Exposure
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the conflict zone without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection in the foreground

hazards.name: Vehicle Conflict Point
hazards.description: Vehicles moving through or turning at the signalized intersection create potential conflict points with pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Black SUV in the center of the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.
